header: GET /api/employees/name-words { words: ["ABHIJIT", "ADITYA", ...] } The NAME WORDS of the directory, and nothing else: no person, no ticket, no department, nothing that says whose word it is. The search bar loads it once, when it opens, to recognise a word as part of an Indian name while the user types ("Looks like a name. Press Enter to search people": src/lib/search/nameHint/nameHint.ts). About 2,900 words, 22 KB; the browser and the edge keep it for ten minutes. I left it open to a person who has not signed in (the name search itself is open to them, and answers with the name and department), and I limit it per address.
